description: The installed KWrite launcher resolves to its real icon and never uses the fallback placeholder; this is an invariant of the fixture image.

assertions.comment: I see the resolved KWrite launcher rather than a raw launcher id; this is an invariant because resolving an installed icon has no runtime stimulus.
I see the real application icon finish loading; this is an invariant because the fixture starts with a resolvable installed icon.
I never see the fallback placeholder for this real icon; exercising the placeholder path itself needs a launcher whose icon cannot be resolved, which this image does not provide.
I see the resolved icon drawn at the default 48px size; this is an invariant of the installed launcher rather than a caused change.
